title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: Flights do most of the heavy lifting.

Santiago to Rapa Nui is a proper long-haul domestic flight. Patagonia then requires another flight south plus road travel through Puerto Natales and Torres del Paine. Punta Arenas connects the final stretch.

Renting a car gives you valuable freedom in the park, but plan fuel, insurance, opening hours and trail logistics before you arrive. We had poor support from our rental provider and would choose more carefully next time.
